selection.rule: Dependency-complete first 24 questions from the question-sheet selection order.

questions.question: What main belief is stated at the beginning of the target passage?
questions.answer: That only Allah is worthy of worship, and that He necessarily exists as the One without partner.

questions.question: According to the passage, what two things together point to Allah’s necessary existence and unity?
questions.answer: True revelations and truthful inspirations both point to it.

questions.question: What does the passage say true revelations include?
questions.answer: They include Allah’s communication, His making Himself known, His answering people’s calls, and His showing His existence to His creatures.

questions.question: What does the passage say truthful inspirations include?
questions.answer: They include signs of Allah’s love, answers to prayers, help for those asking for aid, and hints of His existence to His creatures.

questions.question: How are revelation and inspiration presented in relation to each other in this passage?
questions.answer: They are shown as agreeing with each other in proving the same truth about Allah.

questions.question: What idea about Allah’s relationship with creation is repeated in both parts?
questions.answer: That Allah lets His creatures know He exists and responds to them.

questions.question: What is the overall purpose of this summary statement in the passage?
questions.answer: To sum up the traveler’s lesson that both revelation and true inspiration are strong proofs of Allah’s existence and oneness.

questions.question: Why does the passage mention both invocations and appeals for aid?
questions.answer: To include different ways people turn to Allah in their need.

questions.question: In this passage, what is the traveler’s lesson mainly about?
questions.answer: It is about recognizing Allah through what comes from the unseen world, especially revelation and inspiration.

questions.question: How does the passage describe Allah in relation to unity?
questions.answer: It describes Him as absolutely one and single.

questions.question: What role does the “consensus” of true revelations play in the passage?
questions.answer: It acts as a united testimony that Allah truly exists and is one.

questions.question: What role does the “agreement” of true inspirations play in the passage?
questions.answer: It also serves as a shared witness to Allah’s existence and unity.

questions.question: What can we infer about Allah from the part about compassionate answers to prayer?
questions.answer: We can infer that Allah is merciful and attentive to His creatures.

questions.question: What can we infer from the part about aid given to servants who call for help?
questions.answer: That Allah supports and helps His servants when they turn to Him.

questions.question: If a student had to state the message of the whole passage in one sentence, what would be a good answer?
questions.answer: All true revelation and true inspiration together show clearly that Allah exists, is one, and cares for His creation.

questions.question: What is the best short summary of the whole target passage?
questions.answer: Revelation and true inspiration both serve as united proofs of Allah’s necessary existence and absolute oneness.

questions.question: What is being summarized “in brief” at the start of the passage?
questions.answer: The lesson the traveler learned about knowing Allah from the unseen world.

questions.question: What two titles for Allah in the passage emphasize His oneness?
questions.answer: The passage describes Him as One and Single.

questions.question: What do true revelations testify to besides Allah’s existence?
questions.answer: They also testify to His unity.

questions.question: Give one example from the passage of what is found within true revelations.
questions.answer: One example is Allah answering the calls of His servants.

questions.question: Give one example from the passage of what is found within truthful inspirations.
questions.answer: One example is Allah’s loving care shown to His creatures.

questions.question: How do revelations and inspirations work together in the passage’s argument?
questions.answer: Each one supports the other in proving the same belief about Allah.

questions.question: What does the passage teach about communication from Allah to His creatures?
questions.answer: It teaches that Allah communicates in ways that make His existence known and show His care.

questions.question: If someone said inspiration and revelation lead to different gods, how would the passage answer?
questions.answer: It would answer that both agree on the same one Allah and both point to His unity.
